title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Chozhan Steps Into a Car Deal
description: Cheran confides in Chandayatha about missing his brothers during their trip. Elsewhere, Chozhan gets involved in a car sale deal to earn a commission for his owner.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Favourite heroes and heroines from Vijay TV serials add star power to the Connect game with fun quizzes and clues. Watch to discover who takes the lead and wins the prizes!

title: Neeya Naana
episodeTitle: The Real Price of Cinema Stunts
description: Stunt actors and families discuss life-threatening risks on Neeya Naana. Gopinath explores career origins, emotional accidents, wives' fears, women's freedom, and offers advice.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil admits bribery and job loss to Ravi, who invites him and Meena over. Meena asks Raji about Senthil's role in Kathir's business and Gomathi senses Thangamayil's son's fever.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu, Meena, and Rohini entertain Vijaya, who completes her fast and wins Parvathy's saree. Warned of Ragu's sabotage, Muthu stays calm to focus on business.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: The Wildcard Round brings fantastic performances that amaze the judges and earn their applause. Watch as the competition unfolds with more surprises and thrilling moments!
